items.label: Effortless Support for Top-Heavy Blooms
items.value: This 13" wide grow-through plant support cage for peonies features three 31.5" tall garden stakes legs, perfectly designed to prevent your peonies, dahlias, and tomatoes from flopping over. A must-have plant support for outdoor plants.

items.label: Durable & Discreet Garden Solution
items.value: this peony rings is made from strong, heavy duty wire coated in dark green UV-stabilized plastic, this peony support cage is built for long life and blends invisibly into your garden beds.

items.label: Intelligent Grow-Through Grid Design
items.value: The unique blossom grid construction of this plant cages & supports provides individual stem support. Simply place the flower support frame early in the season, and your plants will grow right through this dahlia cages and supports for natural, sturdy stability.

items.label: Quick & Secure Installation
items.value: Our plant stakes and garden hoops are incredibly easy to use. Just push the dahlia plant support legs deep into the soil for instant, rock-solid upper plant stability. this garden supports for dahlias is Ideal for hydrangea support, roses, and more.

items.label: Versatile Plant Protection System
items.value: More than just peony cages and supports, this versatile plant support ring is perfect for a wide range of tall, bushy flowers and vegetables like begonias and tomatoes, keeping your garden neat all season.
